name: agent-remote-driver-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-remote-driver on a fresh machine and prove launch-time discovery and HTTP admission -- no agent-worktrees or agent-bridge installed in the venue, NO model turn submitted (genuinely credit-free: a bare interactive `copilot` session is kept alive under a pty via `script`, with no prompt ever typed). A live copilot session writes a discovery descriptor at ~/.copilot/remote-driver/sessions/<id>.json, /health and /events answer over authenticated loopback, and /send receives only {} and must return HTTP 400 with the missing-content validation error before SDK send. Real prompt delivery is NOT exercised. The descriptor's bearer token is never persisted unredacted, bin/list-sessions.mjs's aggregated view reflects the live session, and a SIGTERM cleanly removes the descriptor (installSignalCleanup). Name-free / public.

config.CR_MARKETPLACE_REPO: ThomasMichon/copilot-extensions (or a container-local directory mounted with -HarnessMount for uncommitted-worktree validation)

stages.title: live session writes a discovery descriptor (no model turn)
observe HTTP surface and reject empty /send (/health, /events, HTTP 400)
bin/list-sessions.mjs aggregated view reflects the live session
SIGTERM is handled cleanly and removes the discovery descriptor
